metadata.title: Medical Device Lifecycle and Recall

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely managing medical devices across installation, update, recall, and end-of-life.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Medical devices, clinical maintenance systems, and recall coordination processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for controlling installation, update, recall, and retirement of medical devices without disrupting patient care.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Changes to medical devices across their lifecycle must not introduce new patient safety risks.

metadata.remarks: Device Lifecycle and Recall defines how medical devices are commissioned, updated, remediated, recalled, and decommissioned in a manner that preserves patient safety, regulatory compliance, and continuity of clinical care. This pattern treats lifecycle governance as a patient safety control rather than a purely operational or IT concern.

components.title: Validated Device Provisioning
components.description: Controlled installation and commissioning of medical devices into clinical environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Insertion of compromised, counterfeit, or improperly configured devices into clinical environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Validated commissioning procedures ensuring devices enter service in a known-safe state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices are commissioned according to validated procedures ensuring correct configuration and clinical safety.

components.title: Controlled Update and Patching
components.description: Safety-aware management of software, firmware, and configuration updates for medical devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or manipulation of updates that leaves devices in a vulnerable or unsafe operational state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled, safety-reviewed updates that reduce risk without disrupting patient care.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Updates to medical devices are evaluated, scheduled, and applied to avoid disruption to patient care.

components.title: Recall and Decommissioning
components.description: Coordinated response to medical device recalls and secure retirement of unsafe or obsolete devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence of unsafe devices through incomplete recall or improper decommissioning.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Coordinated recall, isolation, and retirement of devices to eliminate patient safety risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical device recalls and decommissioning activities are executed to protect patient safety and clinical continuity.
